description: NIST FIPS 197 (Advanced Encryption Standard) Appendix C known-answer vectors for the single-block forward cipher, used to validate the RustCrypto AES core of the optional accelerated backend (plan 00003 STEP-09, REQ-15).

provenance.source: NIST FIPS 197, Advanced Encryption Standard (AES), updated 2023-05-09, Appendix C (Examples)
provenance.transcription_check: Each ciphertext was independently verified against the OpenSSL-backed AES in the Python 'cryptography' package (Cipher(algorithms.AES(key), modes.ECB())) before freezing; these values are never generated from fpr-ff1 or the Rust backend under test.
